title: Restore 'You made me the happiest' text in CelebrationScreen

requirements.summary: Restore the 'You made me the happiest' line to its original prominent, emotionally sincere form in the CelebrationScreen component
acceptanceCriteria: The CelebrationScreen displays a prominent line expressing 'You made me the happiest' (or equivalent strong phrasing) after the user clicks Yes.
The line is not softened, diluted, or replaced with lighter casual phrasing.
The line is styled consistently with the existing Slytherin/Harry Potter magical theme and typography.
No 🥺 emoji appears in the line or anywhere else on the CelebrationScreen.
All other CelebrationScreen content and styling remains unchanged.

file_operations.description: Restore the 'You made me the happiest' line to its original prominent, heartfelt form (e.g., 'You made me the happiest person in the world' or 'You just made me the happiest'). Replace the current lighter casual messaging ('Yay, we're talking again!') with this strong, emotionally sincere expression. Ensure the line is prominently displayed, uses consistent Slytherin/Harry Potter magical theme typography (Cinzel or Crimson Text), and remains free of the 🥺 emoji. Preserve all other content, confetti effects, floating magical emoji particles, and styling unchanged.
